requirementValidation.heading: Provider and Worker Responsibilities
requirementValidation.countedContent: Providers and workers are responsible for delivering supports in accordance with the participant's goals and preferences, ensuring safety and dignity at all times.

requirementValidation.heading: Participant, Representative and Support-Network Responsibilities
requirementValidation.countedContent: Participants and their representatives are responsible for communicating their needs and preferences clearly and for participating actively in their support planning.

requirementValidation.text: Health, medication, behaviour support and restrictive-practice boundaries
requirementValidation.target: User-facing representation of Health, medication, behaviour support and restrictive-practice boundaries
requirementValidation.heading: Health, Medication, Behaviour Support and Restrictive-Practice Boundaries
requirementValidation.countedContent: Health and medication support will be provided as per the participant’s health plan. Behaviour support strategies must align with the approved Behaviour Support Plan.

requirementValidation.text: Risk, safety, incident and escalation arrangements
requirementValidation.target: User-facing representation of Risk, safety, incident and escalation arrangements
requirementValidation.heading: Risk, Safety, Incident and Escalation Arrangements
requirementValidation.countedContent: Risk management strategies will be implemented to ensure participant safety. In case of incidents, the following escalation pathways must be followed: [ESCALATION_PATHWAYS]

requirementValidation.target: User-facing representation of Community participation and service-delivery coordination
requirementValidation.heading: Community Participation and Service-Delivery Coordination
requirementValidation.countedContent: Community participation will be encouraged through various activities. Coordination of services will be managed by the support coordinator.

requirementValidation.text: Review, updates, consent and sign-off provisions
requirementValidation.target: Supervision, check-in and sign-off checklist section
requirementValidation.heading: Review, Updates, Consent and Sign-off Provisions
requirementValidation.countedContent: The care plan will be reviewed on [REVIEW_DATE]. All changes must be documented and consented to by the participant or their representative.
